maya: Heads-up — on-boarding openchat-7b->Redwood. Running hf chat_template conversion and seeing assistant messages glued to system text plus stray sentinel tokens in the rendered prompt. Repro below, fairly deterministic.

alex: Can you paste the jinja snippet? and the converter cmd you used?

maya: ```jinja
{% if user_instructions %}
SYSTEM: {{ system_instructions }}
{% endif %}
{% for turn in turns %}
<|user|>{{ turn.user }}
{% if turn.assistant %}<|assistant|>{{ turn.assistant }}
{% endif %}
{% endfor %}
```

maya: Converter: `python -m rw_convert --model-dir ./hf/openchat-7b --template chat_template.jinja --out redwood_chat.json`

jin: I think I saw this before. The HF `chat_template` had a sentinel token set to `` in config.json. On conversion we were not inserting a separator; tokenizer merges `assistant` role marker with the EOS special token id mapping when quantized. Output looks like: `SYSTEM: ...<|assistant|>Some reply`` — note double sentinel ending up inline.

alex: Ugh. Does the HF tokenizer have both `bos` and `eos` defined? sometimes the converter expects `eos` id to be reserved and rewrites it.

maya: config.json has: "bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "", "additional_special_tokens": ["<|assistant|>", "<|user|>" ] 

jin: That's the problem — `` is treated as a single token by HF tokenizer, but the converter was emitting it verbatim (not as a token tokenized separately) so when the runtime runs quantized 4-bit kernels we end up with token id collisions and wrong KV cache boundaries. Repro: tokenized string length differs between HF tokenizer and the Redwood runtime mapping.

sara: Workaround for now: edit the jinja to force explicit whitespace and a neutral separator, e.g. `
<|assistant|> {{ turn.assistant }} <|sep|>
` and add `<|sep|>` to additional_special_tokens in config.json. That changed the rendered prompt and fixed the immediate concat for our eval.

alex: Good hotfix. But we need the converter to be robust: two fixes I suggest — 1) normalize special tokens from config.json and rewrite EOF token to `<|eos|>` canonical token (or at least map to an ID in tokenizer) 2) ensure converter emits a space when joining role markers and message bodies unless template explicitly suppresses it.

jin: I started a quick patch: `rw_convert/convert_chat.py` change — when reading `additional_special_tokens` create a mapping and inject a sentinel spacer token if any of them end or start with `` or no whitespace. Also add a `--inject-sep-token` flag.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: k8s deploy for openchat-7b failed: pod crashloopbackoff. Reason: model vocab mismatch: unknown token id 50256 referenced at runtime init. Related issue: tokenizer.json didn't include the `` entry in the expected position after conversion.

maya: Noted. After jin's patch, can we run the quantized eval suite (summarization + chat coherency) on the 4-bit build? Current smoke shows 12% ROUGE drop vs HF baseline when using converted templates.

jin: Will do. Plan: patch converter -> regenerate tokenizer+vocab mappings -> run `./tools/eval/quant_regression.sh openchat-7b 4bit` -> collect `regressions.csv`.

sara: Also add a unit test for jinja templates that assert there is always whitespace between role markers and message starts in the rendered output unless template explicitly uses `|no_space|` macro.

maya: Cool. Assigning to jin + maya to own the fix and to run evals. I'll attach a minimal repro and the failing `redwood_chat.json` with token id diff.

alex: Thanks. Once fixed we should re-run canary A/B on Dedicated and watch latency delta for quant path.

ops-bot: incident-tracker: created issue RW-2387: `chat_template conversion: sentinel & tokenizer mapping causes assistant concat + quant reg` (assigned to jin, maya) :thumbsup:

maya: I'll push the repro and an example `config.json` to the issue.

jin: Patch incoming in ~2h.

sara: Nice. If patch is low-risk we can roll to staging and run the nightly evals. :rocket:

maya: Thanks all.
